messages:
kiran: FYI customer acme-analytics just flagged they lost access to model 'finbert-v2' in their workspace after last night's role cleanup. they can still see models list but GET /models/finbert-v2 returns 403 for their svc account.

support-bot: New ticket created: #45672 (tenant: acme-analytics). Assigned to @ella.

ella: thanks — tagged @raj from sec to help triage. kiran can you paste recent audit entry or role-change job id?

kiran: grabbing audit.. here's the relevant linea from audit logs: `2026-03-19T03:12:04Z user=sysadmin action=rolesync job_id=rs-20260319-71 target=tenant:acme-analytics removed_role=project:model-editor`

ella: aha. so the rolesync removed the project-scoped role that grants model access. was this an intentional flattening?

raj: we ran a permissions squash last night to dedupe roles across tenants, but there was a bug in the matcher for project-scoped bindings. it treated `project:model-editor` as stale and removed it. reproducing now.

kiran: customer reports they rely on the svc account to call model inference. consequence: production jobs failing, alerting ops. need fast restore and an RCA.

ella: action plan: 1) restore the role binding for acme svc account 2) re-run rolesync with fix in dry-run then prod 3) notify customer and ops. anyone object?

raj: agree. quick restore command (run by infra with perms):
```
rbacctl grant --tenant acme-analytics --principal svc:acme-infer --role project:model-editor --scope project:fin
```
I'll follow up with a patched rolesync release.

kiran: running the grant now (I'll escalate to infra team for permission).

support-bot: Deploy job infra-grants-991 started by kiran at 03:24:11Z.

ella: after restore please confirm inference call works: example curl we can ask customer to try: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/finbert-v2:predict -d '{"inputs":"Test"}'`

kiran: infra confirmed grant completed at 03:27. i asked customer to retry. they say inference succeeded and jobs recovered.

raj: created PR with fix for the matcher (refs: github.com/redwood/perm-sync/pull/342). adding an integration test to catch dropped project-scoped roles.

ella: I've drafted customer message: "we identified a rolesync bug that removed a project-scoped role; we've restored your svc account binding and deployed a fix; we'll run a follow-up audit and provide a post-incident report." anyone want to edit?

kiran: please add note about rotated temporary keys (we provided a scoped token) and that we logged all changes to the tenant audit trail.

raj: doing a postmortem runbook: cause = matcher treating `project:*` as global; immediate fix = restore binding + patch matcher; long-term = integration test + canary run for rolesync that validates active tenants.

ella: thanks team. i'm closing ticket #45672 after sending customer ack. will attach logs and PR links.

kiran: thanks. adding a follow-up task for compliance to verify KMS access wasn't affected (customer asked about keys).

support-bot: Ticket #45672 status: resolved by ella at 2026-03-19T03:45:23Z.
